drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial draft for discussion, subject to client review and approval. The settlement amount and payment deadline remain open. We have clarified that the release takes effect upon receipt of payment and added customary exceptions to confidentiality. Please confirm the proposed payment terms and whether the release should be limited to claims arising from the underlying dispute.

edits.text: Permanently remove the tracked-deleted internal note; do not restore its text or retain it in revision history.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT AND CURRENCY TO BE AGREED] in immediately available funds by [PAYMENT DEADLINE TO BE AGREED], using payment instructions separately confirmed by the parties.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. This release does not release either party’s obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations, disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement, and disclosures required by law or court order. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful communications with, or cooperation with, governmental or regulatory authorities.
